fr-2020-10856.orig: Export Administration Regulations: Amendments to General Prohibition Three (Foreign-Produced Direct Product Rule) and the Entity List
fr-2020-10856.quote: "This rule amends General Prohibition Three, also known as the foreign-produced direct product rule, by exercising existing authority under the Export Control Reform Act of 2018 (ECRA), to impose a new control over certain foreign-produced items, when there is knowledge that such items are destined to a designated entity on the Entity List."
fr-2020-10856.ko: 이 규칙은 해외직접생산품 규칙으로도 알려진 일반금지 3을, 2018년 수출통제개혁법(ECRA)에 따른 기존 권한을 행사하여 개정함으로써, 해당 품목이 수출제한 대상 목록의 지정 기관을 목적지로 한다는 것을 알고 있는 경우 특정 해외 생산 품목에 대한 새로운 통제를 부과한다.
